jobs.descriptionText:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
Sr. Associate Director, Technology Management
.
Business:CTO Infrastructure
Principal Responsibilities
Leveraging Strategic Partnerships workstream: Own the programme management of IDP's partnerships workstream feeding the Group AI programme – building and maintaining the plan, milestones, dependencies, RAID log and financials, and ensuring the workstream delivers against the commitments made into the wider programme.
Programme governance and reporting: Run the governance and reporting cycle for the workstream – preparing status reporting, steering and programme board submissions, and ensuring a single, accurate and timely view of progress, risk and value is available to the Group AI programme and to IDP leadership.
Cross-workstream integration: Act as IDP's interface into the Group AI programme, managing dependencies with other workstreams, escalating blockers, and ensuring partnership commitments, timelines and benefits are reflected consistently in the overall programme view.
Strategy development and execution: Support the Director of IDP in shaping and refreshing the function's strategy – conducting analysis, developing options and recommendations, translating agreed direction into objectives, roadmaps and measurable outcomes, and tracking delivery against them.
Operating rhythm and governance: Run the operating rhythm for the Director of IDP and the leadership team – setting agendas, preparing materials, capturing decisions and actions, and driving follow-through to closure.
Team effectiveness and organisational health: Support the Director of IDP on organisational and team matters, including onboarding, colleague engagement, internal communications, capability planning and cultural initiatives that sustain a high-performing global team.
Special initiatives: Lead strategic initiatives and analyses on behalf of the Director of IDP where dedicated focus is required, from framing the problem through to a decision-ready recommendation and implementation.
Requirements
Programme management: Proven track record of managing complex, multi-stakeholder programmes or workstreams in a large organisation – planning, dependency and risk management, governance, and reporting into senior programme structures.
Strategic analysis: Ability to structure ambiguous problems, conduct rigorous analysis, and develop clear, decision-ready recommendations for a senior audience.
Executive communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication, with demonstrable experience producing materials for executive and Board-level audiences.
Stakeholder engagement: Strong grasp of engaging with diverse stakeholders, covering business, technology and external partnerships, to align innovation efforts with bank priorities.
AI: Working knowledge of artificial intelligence and its practical application in financial services – sufficient to engage credibly with technical colleagues and strategic partners, and to translate technical progress into business terms.
Partnerships: Understanding of how strategic technology and AI partnerships are structured, governed and commercially realised within a large, regulated organisation.
Strategic: Proven track record in translating strategy into executable plans and measurable outcomes.
/WX/LP
You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.
HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited***

jobs.descriptionText:
HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)
Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Private Banking and Insurance.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.
In This Role, You Will
Developing our Premier Elite customer base and establishing long term relationships with an assigned Premier Elite clientele portfolio
Managing the total wealth of your clients by matching our financial and investment product solutions to their financial needs
Promoting our Premier Elite Service to potential customers, exploring their needs and making referrals to other business units where appropriate
Supporting branch improvement initiatives, providing customer feedback of our service, and ensuring compliance with audit requirements and quality assurance
Premier Relationship Director require exceptional ability to build trusting relationships with existing and potential Premier Elite clients, help clients articulate their needs, and deliver to exceed client expectations.
扩大卓越尊尚客户群，并与卓越尊尚客户建立长期关系
根据卓越尊尚客户的财务需求提供合适的金融及投资产品服务，管理客户的财富
向潜在客户推广卓越理财服务，发掘他们的需求并且在适当的情况下推荐客户至其他业务部门
配合执行分行改进措施，反映客户的意见，并确保符合分行的运作要求和品质保证
卓越尊尚客户总监需要具备与现有客户和潜在客户建立互信的关系，帮助客户表达真实需求，以及帮助客户达成期望的能力
Qualifications
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:
University level education, preferably in finance, business, or a related discipline
At least 5 years as Relationship Manager.
Experience in client facing environment, with excellent relationship building capability
Strong sales and customer orientation, with good communication and interpersonal skills
High level of customer centricity mindset with dedication to deliver exceptional quality services for customers
Good understanding and strong interest of the financial markets
Mature and independent mindset, able to work effectively under pressure
Strong commercial orientation with acute interpersonal skills
Fluency in Mandarin and English
本科及以上学历，金融、商科或相关学科更佳
至少5年以上客户经理经验
具有前线客户服务经验，善于建立客户关系
具有优秀销售及客户服务技巧，善于沟通及人际交流
以客户为本，致力为客户提供优质服务
了解并对金融市场有浓厚兴趣
成熟独立，能在压力下有良好表现
具有出色商业思维及敏锐人际技巧
普通话及英语流利
我们的福利
汇丰为员工提供全面、贴心的关怀与福利，自入职第一天起，员工就可以在多样化和人性化的工作场所做出积极选择，满足自己多层次的需求。
假期福利
除法定休假外，有年假、带薪病假、志愿者假、妇女节、休假等。您入职后即可享有10~25天的丰厚年假，让您在工作之余有充分的时间放松身心。在您生日当月，更有一天生日假，您可以和家人、朋友等一起庆祝这温馨的时刻。
全面的福利保险计划
包括定期寿险、意外伤亡险、重疾险、补充商业医疗保险等，覆盖全方位生活场景，为您的保障添砖加瓦。
员工体检
每年为您提供一次关爱体检，有多种套餐，全面评估您的身体状况和生活方式，帮助您实现健康生活、快乐工作。
弹性福利
当您考虑为家庭提供更多保障时，My Choice员工弹性福利平台可以满足您不同人生阶段的各种需求。每年您都享有弹性福利积分，可以调整您的福利保险，买卖年假，为家人购买体检套餐等，DIY一份专属于您的福利计划。
心理健康咨询
您和您的直系亲属均可免费获得专业的心理健康咨询，包含个人成长、缓解职场压力、解决情感困惑等，助您一路“升级打怪”，稳步前进。
企业年金
汇丰企业年金这一补充养老金计划为您更添一份保障。建立企业账户和个人账户，由汇丰和您按照一定比例每月缴存。更有专业的金融机构共同运营，确保年金资金的安全独立、灵活投资，您可在退休时领取，提升您退休后的生活品质。
弹性工作
为了让大家发挥最佳表现，您有各种弹性工作的灵活选择。
PSQP专业进修计划
专业进修计划通过为员工报销学费的方式鼓励员工追求职业发展。员工可就经PSQP批核的进修计划和经批核学位列表中涵盖的专业进修享受学费报销

jobs.descriptionHtml:
l ocation : Shanghai/Shenzhen/Guangzhou

Global Private Banking & Wealth

International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance. HSBC Private Banking helps high net worth and ultra-high net worth clients manage, grow, and preserve their wealth for generations to come. Our network of global experts helps clients access investment opportunities around the world, plan for future with wealth and succession planning, manage their portfolio with tailored solutions, and find the right support for their philanthropy.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • To maximize HSBC's network in CIB, BB, IWPB, HK Business and UK Business to grow quality clients for PB;
  • To develop the collaboration strategies, and align interest with other line of businesses and other PB booking centers;
  • To manage collaboration activities between GPB China and other Global Businesses across markets including but not limited to Hong Kong, Singapore, United Kingdom, UAE and United States;
  • To establish attractive internal marketing programs and scheme to contribute prospecting and relationship building with internal partners and stakeholders;
  • To track and review collaboration effort, and provide insights to GPB management;
  • To ensure support from the partners from other Global Businesses and GPB market teams by proactively managing and strengthening the relationship with key stakeholders.

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • Relevant qualifications and over 6 years of relevant experience in financial institutions;
  • Broad knowledge of universal banking model, with preference in corporate banking, investment banking and wealth management;
  • Strong data analytics and interpretation capabilities, and proficient in various MS office applications (ppt, excel etc.);
  • Fluent in English and Chinese speaking, and professional English writing;
  • Ability to think innovatively, shaping and communicating new concepts;
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, in order to engage internal and external business stakeholders;

jobs.descriptionText:
Some careers have more impact than others.
If you’re looking for further opportunities to develop your career, take the next step in fulfilling your potential right here at HSBC.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
Head of Engineering- PE, Application Platforms.
Business:CTO
Job ID：58472
The Opportunity
CTO Platform Engineering & Architecture (CTOp), within the CTO, builds next-gen application and AI platforms that cut toil through open-source and automated controls, so teams ship code (and containers) faster, safer and more reliably.
This hands-on Head of Engineering, Principal role leads Application Platform Engineering in partnership with the Head of Application Platforms, owning outcomes end-to-end from strategy and roadmap to transparent governance and predictable delivery.
You’ll combine big-picture platform architecture with hands-on implementation to drive ~80% migration to the standard platform and consolidate six hosting platforms into one resilient, well-controlled estate, strengthening observability, operational readiness and measurable engineering standards.
What You’ll Do
Leading the engineering function for Application Platform Engineering, covering strategic direction and day-to-day execution.
Supporting the Head of Application Platforms with end-to-end ownership of delivery, controls, and outcomes across the team.
Establishing and operating effective governance, including prioritisation, delivery cadence, and decision-making forums.
Defining, implementing, and tracking measurable engineering standards to improve quality, reliability, and consistency.
Driving the migration strategy and execution to achieve ~80% application migration onto the standard platform.
Leading the consolidation of six hosting platforms into a standard platform to reduce complexity and operational risk.
Improving platform resilience and time-to-market through standard patterns, reusable capabilities, and streamlined delivery.
Ensuring consistent observability practices (monitoring, logging, alerting) across the platform and migrated applications.
Implementing automated run controls to strengthen operational management and reduce manual intervention.
Managing delivery and control outcomes, ensuring transparency through metrics, reporting, and continuous improvement.
Partnering with stakeholders across technology and delivery to align priorities, manage dependencies, and remove blockers.
What You Will Need To Succeed In The Role
We are agnostic - focused on impact and outcomes: You may come with Java, Python, Node, C, C++, C# or any other coding language.
14+ years’ relevant senior engineering leadership experience in Platform Engineering and/or large-scale application hosting environments.
Proven track record delivering complex technology change across multiple teams, including platform consolidation and migration programmes.
Strong experience establishing governance, prioritisation, and delivery management practices in an engineering-led environment.
Demonstrable ability to define and embed engineering standards with measurable outcomes (e.g., reliability, quality, delivery performance).
Strong understanding of resilience engineering, operational risk management, and controls within enterprise technology environments.
Strong knowledge of observability practices and operating models (monitoring, logging, alerting, SLOs/SLAs, incident management).
Experience implementing automation for operational controls (e.g., automated runbooks, policy-as-code, standardised controls).
Ability to drive standardisation through consistent engineering patterns and reusable platform capabilities.
Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills across senior technology leadership and delivery partners.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, able to translate strategy into executable plans and clear outcomes.
Demonstrated leadership behaviours that build inclusive, high-performing teams, with clear accountability and a focus on delivery outcome.
Note that this is a hands-on role and will be a Principal Engineer, there will be an expectation that they deliver code through to production.
Ideally, you are capable of writing Linux kernel, know Kubernetes, understand networks from packets to TCP/UDP to service mesh.
